msg: Hi, I'm from Texas and I'm trying to book the 2-dive trip from Cartagena for tomorrow-ish, just me, Open Water. My card keeps getting declined on your website. Is there another way to pay? I don't want to lose the online discount.
reply:
If the website payment keeps failing, the team can arrange a bank-transfer payment link, and you’ll keep the 10% online discount because the online payment failed. Please try again in a few minutes and double-check your card details; if it still doesn’t work, the team can help coordinate the alternative payment.

This depends on real-time availability or support. I'll connect you with someone from the team to help you now.
